questions.promptMd: You need reproducible model outputs in an automated test. Which combination is most appropriate?

options.textMd: Temperature 0 (or a fixed seed at temperature 0) against the real model
A fake provider returning scripted responses

questions.explanationMd: CI has no model running, so only a fake provider is actually reproducible there. Option b is reasonable locally, but even temperature 0 is not guaranteed identical across model versions or hardware.

questions.promptMd: A structured-output response fails Zod validation in production. What is the *first* thing that should happen?

options.textMd: Return the raw text to the user and let them sort it out
Increment a parse-failure metric, then retry once with the validation error fed back in
Raise the temperature and try again

questions.explanationMd: Every parse failure is a signal: count it, then recover. Silent substitution destroys the evidence, and raising the temperature makes valid output less likely, not more.
